scope: Minimal SwiftUI App startup, same five native UILabel content rows; bound empty [Int] NavigationStack path and one Int destination; toolbar adds inline Journals title and Menu/Next text buttons. No Logseq, LUI, OCaml, graph loading, probes or Instruments.
method: Same installed -O binary, runtime environment selects one of three AnyView branches; two batches of seven randomized interleaved rounds with fresh processes; OS caches retained; cumulative competing-work CPU guard before and during every launch; five actual drawn labels required at commit and display callback follows estimated presentation.
limitations: Fresh processes with retained OS caches, not reboot-to-launch measurements.
A conservative display callback follows the five drawn labels’ content commit; this is not a direct scanout measurement.
The navigation mode includes an empty bound [Int] path and a registered Int destination. Toolbar adds inline title and two text buttons.
This measures root navigation construction at cold launch, not push/pop animation latency.
Phase medians and medians of paired differences are not additive.
Minimal controls contain no Logseq/LUI/core/graph and do not establish a platform floor or complete-app optimization.
